freeze_audit_reason.name: freeze_audit_reason
freeze_audit_reason.value: "freeze_audit"."action" NOT IN ('recover', 'incomplete') OR "freeze_audit"."reason" IS NOT NULL

compute_artifacts_shape.name: compute_artifacts_shape
compute_artifacts_shape.value: ("compute_artifacts"."ref_type" = 'attachment') = ("compute_artifacts"."unit_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("compute_artifacts"."ref_type" = 'external') = ("compute_artifacts"."uri" IS NOT NULL) AND ("compute_artifacts"."ref_type" = 'external' OR "compute_artifacts"."sha256" IS NOT NULL)

compute_packages_configuration.name: compute_packages_configuration
compute_packages_configuration.value: ("compute_packages"."configuration_sha256" IS NULL) = ("compute_packages"."configuration_bytes" = 0) AND "compute_packages"."configuration_bytes" >= 0 AND "compute_packages"."configuration_bytes" <= 262144 AND ("compute_packages"."configuration_sha256" IS NULL OR length("compute_packages"."configuration_sha256") = 64)

compute_scopes_shape.name: compute_scopes_shape
compute_scopes_shape.value: ("compute_scopes"."schema_id" IS NULL) = ("compute_scopes"."schema_version" IS NULL) AND ("compute_scopes"."schema_id" IS NULL) = ("compute_scopes"."generic_text" IS NOT NULL)

consent_requests_change_pair.name: consent_requests_change_pair
consent_requests_change_pair.value: "consent_requests"."tokens_deleted_at" IS NOT NULL OR (("consent_requests"."change_token_hash" IS NULL) = ("consent_requests"."change_expires_at" IS NULL) AND ("consent_requests"."change_token_hash" IS NULL OR "consent_requests"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL))

consent_requests_tokens_deleted.name: consent_requests_tokens_deleted
consent_requests_tokens_deleted.value: ("consent_requests"."tokens_deleted_at" IS NULL) = ("consent_requests"."token_hash" IS NOT NULL) AND ("consent_requests"."tokens_deleted_at" IS NULL OR "consent_requests"."change_token_hash" IS NULL)

consent_requests_state_stamp.name: consent_requests_state_stamp
consent_requests_state_stamp.value: ("consent_requests"."state" = 'answered') = ("consent_requests"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("consent_requests"."state" = 'cancelled') = ("consent_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("consent_requests"."state" = 'expired') = ("consent_requests"."expired_at" IS NOT NULL)

dual_approvals_decided_pair.name: dual_approvals_decided_pair
dual_approvals_decided_pair.value: ("dual_approvals"."state" = 'open') = ("dual_approvals"."decided_by" IS NULL) AND ("dual_approvals"."decided_by" IS NULL) = ("dual_approvals"."decided_at" IS NULL)

decisions_outcome_shape.name: decisions_outcome_shape
decisions_outcome_shape.value: COALESCE("decisions"."outcome_kind" = 'selected', 0) = ("decisions"."outcome_alternative" IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE("decisions"."outcome_kind" = 'deferred', 0) OR "decisions"."outcome_reason" IS NULL)

saved_drafts_target_root.name: saved_drafts_target_root
saved_drafts_target_root.value: "saved_drafts"."target_id" IS NULL OR "saved_drafts"."target_root_id" IS NOT NULL

saved_drafts_base_rev.name: saved_drafts_base_rev
saved_drafts_base_rev.value: "saved_drafts"."base_rev" IS NULL OR "saved_drafts"."target_id" IS NOT NULL

edit_proposals_accepted_pair.name: edit_proposals_accepted_pair
edit_proposals_accepted_pair.value: ("edit_proposals"."state" = 'accepted') = ("edit_proposals"."accepted_by" IS NOT NULL) AND ("edit_proposals"."accepted_by" IS NULL) = ("edit_proposals"."accepted_at" IS NULL)

research_releases_sealed_shape.name: research_releases_sealed_shape
research_releases_sealed_shape.value: ("research_releases"."state" = 'draft') = ("research_releases"."manifest_hash" IS NULL AND "research_releases"."manifest_mac" IS NULL AND "research_releases"."public_manifest_hash" IS NULL AND "research_releases"."sealed_at" IS NULL AND "research_releases"."sealed_by" IS NULL)

research_releases_digests.name: research_releases_digests
research_releases_digests.value: ("research_releases"."manifest_hash" IS NULL OR length("research_releases"."manifest_hash") = 64) AND ("research_releases"."public_manifest_hash" IS NULL OR length("research_releases"."public_manifest_hash") = 64) AND length("research_releases"."contents_digest") = 64

research_releases_published_pair.name: research_releases_published_pair
research_releases_published_pair.value: ("research_releases"."published_at" IS NULL) = ("research_releases"."published_by" IS NULL) AND ("research_releases"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL) = ("research_releases"."withdrawn_by" IS NULL)

research_releases_published_state.name: research_releases_published_state
research_releases_published_state.value: ("research_releases"."published_at" IS NULL OR "research_releases"."state" IN ('published', 'withdrawn')) AND ("research_releases"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL OR "research_releases"."state" = 'withdrawn')

external_parties_email_erasure.name: external_parties_email_erasure
external_parties_email_erasure.value: ("external_parties"."contact_email_erased_by" IS NULL) = ("external_parties"."contact_email_erased_at" IS NULL) AND ("external_parties"."contact_email_erased_at" IS NULL OR "external_parties"."contact_email" IS NULL)

review_requests_reviewed.name: review_requests_reviewed
review_requests_reviewed.value: ("review_requests"."state" = 'reviewed') = ("review_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "review_requests"."reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL)

review_requests_outcome_publication.name: review_requests_outcome_publication
review_requests_outcome_publication.value: "review_requests"."outcome" IS NULL OR ("review_requests"."state" = 'reviewed' AND (("review_requests"."request_type" = 'publication_request' AND "review_requests"."outcome" IN ('applied', 'declined')) OR ("review_requests"."request_type" = 'proposal' AND "review_requests"."outcome" IN ('approved', 'declined'))))

run_counts_digits.name: run_counts_digits
run_counts_digits.value: typeof("run_counts"."value") = 'text' AND length("run_counts"."value") BETWEEN 1 AND 30 AND "run_counts"."value" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'

sources_range_start.name: sources_range_start
sources_range_start.value: "sources"."doc_date_end" IS NULL OR "sources"."doc_date" IS NOT NULL

outside_submissions_contact_review.name: outside_submissions_contact_review
outside_submissions_contact_review.where: "outside_submissions"."contact_review_due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "outside_submissions"."email_erased_at" IS NULL

submitter_corrections_erase_values.name: submitter_corrections_erase_values
submitter_corrections_erase_values.value: "submitter_corrections"."erased" = 0 OR ("submitter_corrections"."new_email" IS NULL AND "submitter_corrections"."prev_email" IS NULL)

submitter_corrections_shape.name: submitter_corrections_shape
submitter_corrections_shape.value:
("submitter_corrections"."kind" = 'attribution' AND "submitter_corrections"."new_email" IS NULL AND "submitter_corrections"."prev_email" IS NULL)
    OR ("submitter_corrections"."kind" = 'contact' AND "submitter_corrections"."new_name" IS NULL AND "submitter_corrections"."new_affiliation" IS NULL AND "submitter_corrections"."prev_name" IS NULL AND "submitter_corrections"."prev_affiliation" IS NULL)
